name: @kontent-ai/oxlint-config
author: Richard Sustek
description: Shared oxlint config and the kontent oxlint JS plugin used by Kontent.ai packages

scripts.prepublishOnly: pnpm run build && pnpm run test
scripts.build: pnpm run lint && pnpm run clean && pnpm run build:ts
scripts.lint: pnpm run knip && pnpm run biome:check && pnpm run oxlint
scripts.bump:patch: pnpm run build && npm version patch -m "v%s" && pnpm run build:ts && git push --follow-tags
scripts.bump:minor: pnpm run build && npm version minor -m "v%s" && pnpm run build:ts && git push --follow-tags
scripts.bump:major: pnpm run build && npm version major -m "v%s" && pnpm run build:ts && git push --follow-tags
